00059   static inline void clear(float *outputSamples, unsigned int numSamples) throw()
00060   {
00061     static const float zeros[8] UGEN_ALIGN = { 0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f, 0.f };
00062     unsigned int numVectors = numSamples >> 3U;
00063     unsigned int numScalars = numSamples & 7U;
00064     
00065     VFP_SWITCH_TO_ARM_ASM;
00066     VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH_ASM(7);
00067     
00068     VFP_FIXED_8_VECTOR_SPLAT_LOAD(zeros);
00069     
00070     while(numVectors--)
00071     {
00072       VFP_FIXED_8_VECTOR_SPLAT_SAVE(outputSamples);
00073     }
00074     
00075     if(numScalars > 0)
00076       memset(outputSamples, 0, numScalars * sizeof(float));
00077         
00078     VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH_ZERO_ASM;
00079     VFP_SWITCH_TO_THUMB_ASM;
00080   }
00081

00083   {

00085   }

00659     div(leftSamples, rightSamples, outputSamples, numSamples);
00660   }
00661   
00662   static inline void div16(const float *leftSamples, 
00663                const float *rightSamples, 
00664                float *outputSamples, 
00665                unsigned int numSamples) throw()
00666   {
00667     unsigned int numVectors = numSamples >> 4U;
00668     unsigned int numScalars = numSamples & 15U;
00669     
00670     VFP_SWITCH_TO_ARM_ASM;
00671     VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH_ASM(7);
00672     
00673     while(numVectors--)
00674     {
00675       VFP_FIXED_16_VECTOR_OP4(VFP_OP_DIV, leftSamples, rightSamples, outputSamples);
00676     }
00677     
00678     VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH_ZERO_ASM;
00679     
00680     while(numScalars--)
00681     {
00682       *outputSamples++ = *leftSamples++ / *leftSamples++;
00683     }
00684     
00685     VFP_SWITCH_TO_THUMB_ASM;
00686     
00687   }

00714   // acummulators
00715   
00716   static inline void muladd(const float *inputSamples, 
00717                 const float *mulSamples, 
00718                 const float *addSamples, 
00719                 float *outputSamples, 
00720                 unsigned int numSamples) throw()
00721   {
00722     unsigned int numVectors = numSamples >> 3U;
00723     unsigned int numScalars = numSamples & 7U;
00724     
00725     VFP_SWITCH_TO_ARM_ASM;
00726     VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH_ASM(7);
00727     
00728     while(numVectors--)
00729     {
00730       VFP_FIXED_8_VECTOR_MULADD_4(inputSamples, mulSamples, addSamples, outputSamples);
00731     }
00732     
00733     VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH_ZERO_ASM;
00734     
00735     while(numScalars--)
00736     {
00737       *outputSamples++ = *inputSamples++ * *mulSamples++ + *addSamples++;
00738     }
00739     
00740     VFP_SWITCH_TO_THUMB_ASM;
00741 
00742   }
00743   
00744   static inline void linlin(const float *inputSamples, 
00745                 const float *inLowSamples, const float *inHighSamples,
00746                 const float *outLowSamples, const float *outHighSamples,
00747                 float *outputSamples, unsigned int numSamples) throw()
00748   {
00749     unsigned int numVectors = numSamples >> 3U;
00750     unsigned int numScalars = numSamples & 7U;
00751     
00752     float data[24] UGEN_ALIGN;
00753     float *inRangeSamples = data;
00754     float *outRangeSamples = inRangeSamples + 8;
00755     float *tempSamples = outRangeSamples + 8;
00756         
00757     VFP_SWITCH_TO_ARM_ASM;
00758     VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH_ASM(7);
00759     
00760     while(numVectors--)
00761     {
00762       VFP_FIXED_8_VECTOR_OP3(VFP_OP_SUB, inHighSamples, inLowSamples, inRangeSamples);
00763       VFP_FIXED_8_VECTOR_OP3(VFP_OP_SUB, outHighSamples, outLowSamples, outRangeSamples);
00764       VFP_FIXED_8_VECTOR_OP3(VFP_OP_SUB, inputSamples, inLowSamples, tempSamples);    
00765       VFP_FIXED_8_VECTOR_OP3(VFP_OP_MUL, tempSamples, outRangeSamples, tempSamples);
00766       VFP_FIXED_8_VECTOR_OP3(VFP_OP_DIV, tempSamples, inRangeSamples, tempSamples);
00767       VFP_FIXED_8_VECTOR_OP3(VFP_OP_ADD, tempSamples, outLowSamples, outputSamples);
00768       inputSamples += 8;
00769       inLowSamples += 8;
00770       inHighSamples += 8;
00771       outLowSamples += 8;
00772       outHighSamples += 8;
00773       outputSamples += 8;
00774     }
00775     
00776     VFP_VECTOR_LENGTH_ZERO_ASM;
00777     
00778     while(numScalars--)
00779     {
00780       *outputSamples++ = ugen::linlin(*inputSamples++,
00781                       *inLowSamples++, *inHighSamples++,
00782                       *outLowSamples++, *outHighSamples++);
00783     }
00784     
00785     VFP_SWITCH_TO_THUMB_ASM;
00786 
00787   }
